visualCharacteristics.purpose: hosts one of www.lufthansa.com's micro-frontends (the trip management) with www's design system
traits: the app renders itself: trip header 'Your trip' with the booking selector, flight cards, content and help columns
no authored text besides the app name

contentPattern.structure: 1 cell: the app name (trip-management, the default). Page metadata post-handler: true when other systems POST <page>.mfe.html.

reuseGuidance: Add another app to APPS in micro-frontend.js (element, script, classes); the design system version is DESIGN_SYSTEM_VERSION there.
